Set-Location -LiteralPath $HOME; $f=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'v2.3.0rc3_check'; $r=Join-Path $f 'v2.3.0rc3_results.txt'; $n='Garmin Running Data Normalizer.lnk'; $dl=(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).NameSpace('shell:Downloads').Self.Path; if (-not $dl) { $dl="$HOME\Downloads" }; if ([bool](Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe' OR Name = 'pythonw.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*garmin_running_data_normalizer*' })) { $o='W10 STOP: the GUI still runs. Quit it on the page, then paste this line again.' } else { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $w1=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $r | Where-Object { $_ -like 'W1 *' }); $one=($w1.Count -eq 1); $was=$one -and ($w1[0] -like '* / settings False / *'); $p=[ordered]@{}; $kept=@(); if ($one -and ($w1[0] -like '* / venv-rc False / *')) { $p['venv-rc']="$HOME\garmin-normalizer-rc" } else { $kept+='venv-rc' }; if ($one -and ($w1[0] -like '* / outputs False / *')) { $p['outputs']="$HOME\GarminRunningData" } else { $kept+='outputs' }; if ($one -and ($w1[0] -like '* / zip-in-downloads False / *')) { $p['zip']=(Join-Path $dl 'synthetic_garmin_export_x12d.zip') } else { $kept+='zip' }; if ($was) { $p['settings']="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer" } else { $kept+='settings' }; $pics=@(); if ($one -and ($w1[0] -like '* / pictures-in-downloads 0 / *')) { $pics=@(@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dl -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'garmin-*.svg' }) | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) } else { $kept+='pictures' }; $left='none'; if ($kept.Count -gt 0) { $left=($kept -join ',') }; $before=(($p.Keys | ForEach-Object { "$_ $(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p[$_])" }) -join ' ') + ' pictures ' + $pics.Count; Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic; foreach ($k in $p.Keys) { $t=$p[$k]; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $t -PathType Container) { [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteDirectory($t, 'AllDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin') } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $t) { [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($t, 'AllDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin') } }; foreach ($t in $pics) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $t) { [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($t, 'AllDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin') } }; $after=(($p.Keys | ForEach-Object { "$_ $(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p[$_])" }) -join ' ') + ' pictures ' + @($pics | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ }).Count; $o=('W10 ' + (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm') + ' / kept ' + $left + ' / before: ' + $before + ' / after: ' + $after + ' / again:' + ' / venv ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\garmin-normalizer") + ' / venv-rc ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\garmin-normalizer-rc") + ' / outputs ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\GarminRunningData") + ' / settings ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer") + ' / settings-file ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer\gui-settings.json") + ' / marks-file ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer\gui-marks.json") + ' / desktop-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) $n)) + ' / start-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Programs')) $n)) + ' / zip-in-downloads ' + (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dl 'synthetic_garmin_export_x12d.zip')) + ' / pictures-in-downloads ' + @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dl -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'garmin-*.svg' }).Count + ' / backend ' + [bool](Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe' OR Name = 'pythonw.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*garmin_running_data_normalizer*' })) }; Add-Content -LiteralPath $r -Value $o -Encoding ASCII; $o
